Compacts exec and bash tool results with tokenjuice reducers.

## Distribution

- Package: `@omnipolymath/tokenjuice`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `@omnipolymath/tokenjuice`

## Surface

- Contracts: `agentToolResultMiddleware`

<!-- omnipolymath-plugin-reference:manual-start -->

## Compaction scope

Tokenjuice compacts Omnipolymath `exec` and `bash` results in embedded runs and
Omnipolymath dynamic tools in the Codex app-server harness. Native codex-rs shell
results returned to the model stay unchanged.

<!-- omnipolymath-plugin-reference:manual-end -->
